description: The `cel` tool (#735) shares the same evaluator as `if`/`while`'s own `mode: cel`, so its own error texts follow the same table: a list index out of range and division by zero, each a `provider: cel` tool with `on_error: continue`. Circuitry's own one-line text, identical in both engines, never a container's contents, a Python tuple repr or a Rust Debug repr.
